title: Uruguayan Manjar Custard
description: A comforting, pungent Uruguayan custard dessert, easy to make and suitable for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.

ingredients.name: 2 1/4 cups whole milk
ingredients.notes: whole milk is essential for a rich custard

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup cornstarch
ingredients.notes: use cornstarch for a smooth custard

instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together 1 cup of milk, sugar, and salt.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar dissolves and the milk is hot but not boiling.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, cornstarch, and vanilla.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm milk mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Return the mixture to the saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in the melted butter.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the egg whites into the custard mixture.
Divide the mixture among 6-8 mini cocottes or ramekins.
Place the cocottes in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
